en.headline: Hong Kong sends record 41 competitors to WorldSkills Shanghai
en.dek: The largest-ever local contingent will take part in 37 skill categories next month, including two events Hong Kong is entering for the first time.
body: Hong Kong will field its largest team yet at the 48th WorldSkills Competition, sending 41 competitors to contest 37 skill categories in Shanghai from 22 to 27 September. The contingent includes first-time entries in software testing and furniture making.

A flag-presentation ceremony was held last week. Acting Secretary for Education Sze Chun-fai and a representative from the Central Government’s Liaison Office attended. The competitors were selected through multi-round assessments organised by the Vocational Training Council, the Construction Industry Council and the Clothing Industry Training Authority.

Hong Kong has taken part in the biennial event since 1997 and has so far collected four gold, two silver and seven bronze medals plus 81 medallions of excellence. Organisers expect about 1,400 young competitors from nearly 70 countries and regions.

zh.headline: 港隊派歷來最多41人出戰上海世界技能大賽
zh.dek: 第48屆世界技能大賽下月在上海舉行，香港派出41名選手參加37個項目，包括首次出戰的軟件測試及家具製作。
body: 第48屆世界技能大賽將於9月22至27日在上海舉行，香港派出歷來最大規模代表團，共41名選手出戰37個技能項目，當中軟件測試及家具製作屬港隊首次參賽。
代表團上周舉行授旗禮，署理教育局局長施俊輝及中聯辦代表出席。選手經職業訓練局、建造業議會及製衣業訓練局合辦的多輪評核後選出。
香港自1997年起參加這項兩年一度的賽事，累積4金2銀7銅及81個優異獎章。今屆賽事預計吸引近70個國家及地區約1,400名年輕選手參賽。
